name: Teletype Clock
description: A classic split-flap airport-board clock. Each digit lives on a dark card split by a center seam — when the time changes, the top flap falls with gravity, reveals the next digit, and the bottom flap lands with a mechanical bounce.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Digits flip every few seconds in demo mode
variations.description: Four HH:MM digit cards. On change, the old digit's top half hinges down on the center seam (ease-in free fall), then the new digit's bottom half swings into place with an overshoot-and-settle bounce. Shading overlays darken the falling flap and light up the landing one for a 3D feel.

props.name: demo
props.description: Advance the clock by one minute on an interval so flips happen constantly (for showcases)

props.name: demoIntervalMs
props.description: Milliseconds between flips in demo mode

props.description: Extra classes for the outer wrapper

features: Two-phase flip: rotateX 0 → -90° fall with ease-in-cubic gravity, then 90 → 0° landing with overshoot bounce
Only transform and opacity are animated — flaps run on the compositor with backface-visibility hidden
Digit halves are full-height numerals clipped by overflow-hidden windows, so the seam cuts each digit cleanly
Lighting overlays: the falling flap darkens as it turns away, the landing flap brightens as it catches light
prefers-reduced-motion: digits swap instantly via useReducedMotion — no flap animation
Mounts at 00:00 and flips to the real time, doubling as an entrance animation with no hydration mismatch
